coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 9 theory code/output blocks + 9 callouts + 2 figures + 1 Theory playground

top_level.attack: Contrasted against V3 roadmap and all theory blocks.
top_level.defense: Accurately names the three real content families; no stale-topic mismatch in learner-facing title.

top_level.current_content: pipeline reanudable con trace por caso, métricas de cola y manejo de proveedor lento, proceso caído y reejecución
top_level.attack: Current artifacts do not earn these claims end-to-end.
top_level.defense: As the target gate, it correctly states the evidence S38 should produce; weakening the tagline would hide rather than fix the defects.
top_level.justification: Repair evidence to meet the gate instead of lowering the gate.

top_level.current_content: En operación de triage (fintech, retail, banca de procesos en Perú y la región), un batch de scoring no puede colgarse por un proveedor lento ni duplicar side effects (efectos sobre el mundo: envío, escritura, gasto) al reiniciar. Aquí aprendes concurrencia correcta, observabilidad (logs, métricas y trazas) y workflows con checkpoint e idempotencia (que un mismo evento procesado dos veces produzca el mismo resultado). Todo con logs sin PII real.
top_level.attack: Checked whether the operational scenario or idempotency intuition is materially false.
top_level.defense: The scenario, external-effect examples, observability signals and duplicate-effect concern are appropriate; the implementation fails them, not this motivation.
top_level.justification: Do not rewrite sound motivation merely because the code is not yet faithful.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Elegir threads, processes o async según bottleneck medido (I/O vs. CPU)
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Comparar threads, processes y async sobre un stage identificado y métricas válidas, teniendo en cuenta build/runtime, liberación del GIL, serialización y equivalencia del resultado, y justificar la elección con un benchmark reproducible.
learning_outcomes.justification: CPU/I/O label alone is insufficient and no actual executor runs today.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Razonar GIL, costo de serialización e IPC con payloads compactos
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Distinguir GIL del build normal, free-threaded/native kernels y medir serialización/round-trip del mecanismo real de IPC con payload mínimo y picklable.
learning_outcomes.justification: json.dumps length is not ProcessPool serialization/IPC.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Aplicar pools, backpressure (queue maxsize) y rate limits (token bucket)
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Ejecutar un pool real con cola acotada por ítems y política de overflow, e implementar un limiter concurrente con refill temporal/429; medir queue depth, throughput, latency/error y recursos bajo carga.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current token bucket is a lifetime quota and playground uses advisory full().

learning_outcomes.current_content: Definir timeouts, cancelación y cierre de recursos en finally
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Ejecutar una operación local realmente lenta con asyncio timeout/wait_for, observar cancelación/elapsed y comprobar cierre de un recurso real ante éxito, timeout y cancellation.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current helper only compares supplied numbers and toggles a boolean.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Emitir logs estructurados, metrics de cola y traces con correlation_id
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Emitir log, métrica y span diferenciados; correlacionar por trace_id/span_id y, cuando aporte, correlation_id de negocio; validar esquema sin PII.
learning_outcomes.justification: One dict is not three observability signals and correlation_id is not trace context.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Redactar PII, definir SLI/SLO y consumir error budget con criterio
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Minimizar o seudonimizar identificadores según política, calcular SLIs desde una ventana válida, definir SLO+window y computar budget permitido/consumido/restante antes de aplicar la policy de estabilidad.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current values are literals and every threshold miss is treated as budget exhaustion.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Implementar estados, checkpoint e idempotency keys sin side effects duplicados
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Implementar estado y deduplicación en store durable, validar transiciones y demostrar con crashes/races que token+mutación son atómicos o reconciliables y que un proceso nuevo no pierde ni duplica efectos.
learning_outcomes.justification: The current code marks done/token before the effect and stores everything in RAM.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Operar retry con backoff, DLQ, replay controlado y runbook de on-call
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Clasificar solo fallos retriables, aplicar backoff validado/cap/jitter/deadline, persistir DLQ con provenance, replayar casos seleccionados tras un fix versionado y ejecutar un runbook real en un drill.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current DLQ/runbook/replay are strings or booleans.

code_blocks.title: s38_map_contract.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Returns static gate names and literal false flags for duplicate_side_effect_ok/pii_in_logs_ok.
code_blocks.improved_content: Return references/results from failure-injection, privacy-schema and backpressure tests; derive gate status from artifacts rather than literals.
code_blocks.justification: A map can document the contract but does not prove it.

code_blocks.title: concurrency_pick.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Classifies wall/cpu by fixed ratios and returns executor names/max_workers as strings; does not run concurrency.
code_blocks.improved_content: Validate measurements, record runtime/build, run plausible executors on same fixture and compare keyed outputs plus latency/throughput/resource metrics.
code_blocks.justification: CE01-CE03 show invalid telemetry can select a model.

code_blocks.title: gil_ser.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Measures UTF-8 JSON length and labels compact payload preferable to a larger dict containing ana@example.pe.
code_blocks.improved_content: Use a reserved synthetic address if needed, derive field allowlist, measure pickle serialization and actual ProcessPool round-trip when that executor is the candidate; compare threads/native alternative where relevant.
code_blocks.justification: JSON size is not the executor's IPC cost.

code_blocks.title: rate_limit.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Correctly uses put_nowait+Full for a maxsize=2 queue; TokenBucket decrements two static tokens forever without time/refill/synchronization.
code_blocks.improved_content: Keep put_nowait/Full, relabel queue as item-count bound, implement synchronized monotonic refill/window and test 429/Retry-After plus load metrics.
code_blocks.justification: The Queue mechanism is good; the rate/window and memory claims are not.

code_blocks.title: timeout.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Compares supplied latency to timeout; toggles a local closed boolean in finally; no wait/cancel/resource.
code_blocks.improved_content: Use asyncio.sleep/local fake under wait_for/timeout and a closable fake/context manager; validate finite nonnegative latency and positive timeout; assert cancellation/close/progress of subsequent work.
code_blocks.justification: The code currently simulates the answer rather than the mechanism.

code_blocks.title: observability.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Returns one dict containing event fields, one nested metric and pii_raw=False; no trace/span.
code_blocks.improved_content: Create separate log/metric/span records with trace_id/span_id and allowlisted fields; test cross-record correlation and forbidden PII keys.
code_blocks.justification: Self-attested booleans and a custom corr do not establish observability/privacy gates.

code_blocks.title: slo.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Compares handwritten p95/error_rate to thresholds; any miss freezes deploys and any pass ships; generic prefix redaction.
code_blocks.improved_content: Compute SLIs from a synthetic window/denominator, validate domains, calculate error-budget consumption across that window and apply explicit policy; use reserved domains and field-aware minimization/masking.
code_blocks.justification: Negative SLIs currently pass and point-in-time status is conflated with budget exhaustion.

code_blocks.title: checkpoint.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Uses global in-memory CKPT/APPLIED; writes done checkpoint, then adds idempotency key, then executes list append; check/add is not atomic.
code_blocks.improved_content: Use durable SQLite/outbox/inbox style store, valid state transitions and atomic UNIQUE claim/mutation or provider idempotency; induce crashes before/after effect and reopen from new process.
code_blocks.justification: Current ordering demonstrates the failure windows the prose warns against.

code_blocks.title: retry_dlq.py
code_blocks.current_behavior: Exponential formula plus route strings; every non-poison kind retries before max; runbook=True literal; no DLQ/replay artifact.
code_blocks.improved_content: Explicit retriable classifier, validated capped jittered backoff/deadline, durable DLQ metadata, controlled replay and versioned runbook/drill.
code_blocks.justification: Permanent unknown failures currently retry and negative parameters are accepted.

callouts.title: Gate de operación
callouts.current_content: Pipeline reanudable con trace por caso, sin PII real en logs y con runbook de proveedor lento / proceso caído / reejecución. Si falta evidencia de idempotencia, no se promociona.
callouts.improved_content: Gate: crash/restart inducido contra store durable; efecto idempotente probado; trace_id/span_id y métricas calculadas; logs allowlist sin PII; slow-provider drill y runbook versionado. Cualquier gate rojo bloquea promoción.
callouts.justification: Defines evidence rather than aspirational nouns.

callouts.title: Mide primero
callouts.current_content: No elijas async ni multiproceso por moda. Profilea el path del caso sintético y documenta bound + elección en el runbook del batch.
callouts.improved_content: No elijas por moda ni por la etiqueta CPU/I/O sola: valida las métricas, registra runtime/build/kernel y compara alternativas plausibles sobre el mismo manifest y oráculo.
callouts.justification: Modern CPython/NumPy make the decision conditional.

callouts.title: Costo de IPC
callouts.current_content: A veces el process pool es más lento que un solo proceso. Mide serialización + queue antes de multiplicar workers.
callouts.justification: Technically correct; CODE-2 must be fixed to actually perform this measurement.

callouts.title: maxsize es política
callouts.current_content: Rechazo seguro con put_nowait + Full (o put con timeout). Documenta en el runbook: drop, block o DLQ de overflow. full() solo es un hint.
callouts.justification: Matches current Python queue semantics and is one of the strongest callouts in the section.

callouts.title: Sin timeout
callouts.current_content: Incidente clásico de operación: un solo proveedor lento satura todos los workers. Timeout + on_fail es obligatorio antes de prod.
callouts.improved_content: Sin timeout, cada llamada lenta puede retener capacidad; suficientes llamadas lentas pueden saturar el pool. Define timeout/deadline y on_fail, y pruébalos con trabajo realmente bloqueado/cancelado antes de producción.
callouts.justification: Avoids the overbroad single-call claim and requires executable evidence.

callouts.title: Tres pilares
callouts.current_content: Logs + metrics + traces. Correlation_id en todo el path. INFO en prod; DEBUG acotado al sandbox sintético.
callouts.improved_content: Logs, métricas y trazas son señales distintas. Propaga trace_id/span_id para trace context y añade correlation_id de negocio cuando aporte; demuestra las tres emisiones antes de llamarlas observabilidad.
callouts.justification: Custom correlation ID is useful but not a trace substitute.

callouts.title: PII en logs
callouts.current_content: Redacta siempre. Correlation_id sí; teléfono o email en claro no. El header X-Corr-Id une requests sin exponer identidad.
callouts.improved_content: Minimiza primero: no registres email/teléfono si no son necesarios. Si una política aprobada exige representar un identificador, aplica masking/pseudonimización field-aware. Valida el esquema de logs; no confíes en pii_raw=False. Correlation/trace IDs deben ser identificadores no sensibles.
callouts.justification: OWASP favors exclusion/de-identification, not a universal generic mask.

callouts.title: Idempotency-Key
callouts.current_content: La key no basta sola: guarda la key aplicada y rechaza reintentos. Formato estable case:step:ver. Checkpoint durable fuera del proceso.
callouts.improved_content: La key identifica la intención lógica y debe persistir fuera del proceso; token y mutación deben ser atómicos o reconciliables. La versión se fija con la operación original para que un retry tardío conserve identidad. Prueba dos workers y crashes a ambos lados del efecto.
callouts.justification: Current callout states good ingredients but omits the atomicity that makes them safe.

callouts.title: Runbook vivo
callouts.current_content: Documento del on-call: síntomas, checks, acciones (restart worker, replay batch, escalar proveedor). Se prueba el fallo antes de prod.
callouts.justification: Correct operational standard; CODE-8 must supply the artifact/drill rather than print True.

figures.current_content: Headline: La cola acotada es un tope de memoria, no un comentario de diseño; sin maxsize crece hasta OOM; con maxsize el productor espera.
figures.improved_content: Headline: La cola acotada limita backlog por número de ítems y transmite backpressure. Note: para convertir ese bound en un presupuesto de RAM, limita/mide también payloads y estado en vuelo.
figures.justification: Python maxsize is item count, not bytes/RSS.

figures.current_content: Timeline: effect occurs, crash before checkpoint, retry repeats; note says checkpoint saves work but repeatable/idempotent step prevents duplicate.
figures.justification: Accurately visualizes the uncertainty window and actually exposes why checkpoint.py is unsafe.

playground.title: Practica backpressure, timeout e idempotencia
playground.current_behavior: Uses q.full() then q.put(); static non-refilling TokenBucket; timeout is a numeric classifier; idempotency only constructs case:step:ver; pii_raw=False literal.
playground.improved_content: Use put_nowait+Full, a clearly-labelled quota or real refill limiter, an actual local timeout/cancellation demo, and a durable duplicate/restart test; derive privacy result from schema validation.
playground.justification: The playground is topical but directly contradicts the section's safe Queue rule and offers false evidence for timeout/idempotency/privacy.
